notes: ZED Mini stereo camera, under-slung below the gripper, mounted rolled 180 deg (image up = node9 -Z). Mesh local frame: +Y is the optical axis (lens front face at y=0.03025), +X is the stereo baseline (lens axes at x=-0.025 / +0.038, 63.0 mm apart), +Z is camera up. The mesh attachment is independent from the optical frame; see pilot/config/calibration/zed_mini.hand_eye.json for the imager origin.
